title: Remove a corpus source at its open in the context hook's re-check test
summary: Tests only. The context hook's re-check test removed a corpus source just before the native capture read it by name. Now that `@inventarch/db` opens each corpus source before reading it through the descriptor, the test removes the source just before that open instead, and still expects `IA-DB-SOURCE-CHANGED` and the host's STALE answer. Nothing changes for consumers: the package's code, behavior and API are the same.
